Name: Nyapu Style Stardew Kids Expanded by AhCuteArt
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[b]INSTALLATION[/b]:
[Main File] CP is just a drag-and-drop into your mods folder, and you're ready to go.
Works with Generic Mod Config Menu
Tina's new portraits are now the default. If you want the original version, then change the settings in the GMCM.

[Optional File] The portrait replacement overwrites the portraits. 
You should get a prompt to replace the original files if you do it right.
If you need more guidance, Nyapu has a great example on their page. 

[b]CREDITS
[/b] Thank you to  [b][url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/193928383-n3cro92/]N3cro92[/url][/b] for writing the CP code of the old version.
Thank you Nyapu for allowing me to use your work as a base.
Thank you, BURAKMESE, for allowing everyone to edit your mod's portraits.
Retextures and new code were done by me, AhCuteArt
Thank you Dolphineisnotafish for helping me when I got stuck writing the code.
Huongle265 for the original designs.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/85714193]medicsun[/url] for new portrait and sprite redesigns.

[b]EXTRA:[/b]
If you would like to see my Nyapu Style WIP please check out my social media or my Nexus page.
